useWhen: Validate a dougaka timeline JSON an operator already holds, or build its ffmpeg render plan with narration cues
avoidWhen: Encoding mp4, generating video or audio with AI, or reaching the dougaka production service, B2 or Kotobase

inputs.aspect: portrait or landscape override for the plan

outputs.validation: ok flag with named validation errors
outputs.plan: ordered segments with frame/voice/text, width/height/fps, bgm and display-only ffmpeg script

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry and owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-24: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with raw JSON-RPC (initialize/initialized/call) on synthetic fixtures plus a kbb stdio integration test; itonami-agent client model-driven turn and deployed profile not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__dougaka__<tool> and does not start MCP subprocesses on peer runs. Data-format compatibility only; no connection to any video service.
requires: cloud-itonami/app-itonami-dougaka checkout at the pinned commit

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve the absolute checkout before writing the client config. The launcher finds nbb.edn from its own path and resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text git dependency into ~/.gitlibs; no cwd is required.
